summary: Mike Sando's Week 6 Pick Six column uses comments from anonymous NFL executives to address the key questions facing the ten Super Bowl contenders with the shortest odds, after the 49ers lost 19-17 at Cleveland and the Eagles lost 20-14 to the Jets. It also covers whether teams go too far "playing to win," whether rookie kickers can be trusted in the playoffs, Sean Payton's timeout problems in Denver, the Giants and Vikings winning too soon, and a few Week 6 stats and notes.
one_line: Mike Sando's Pick Six column uses NFL executive comments to assess Super Bowl contenders' weaknesses, plus aggressive play-calling, rookie kickers, Broncos timeouts, and Giants and Vikings expectations.
key_facts: The San Francisco 49ers entered Week 6 on a 15-game winning streak and lost 19-17 at Cleveland; rookie kicker Jake Moody missed from 41 yards.

The Kansas City Chiefs have never averaged fewer points through six games or a full season since Patrick Mahomes became quarterback, but their average point differential of 9.8 per game is the largest of that era.
The Chiefs average 9.5 plays per touchdown drive when starting at least 70 yards from the opponent's goal line, up from 7.8 in Mahomes' first year as starter, per TruMedia.
The Eagles gain more than 15 yards on just 11 percent of pass plays, down from 21 percent through six games last season and 19 percent for 2022 overall.
The Detroit Lions are 11.3 EPA per game better on defense than last season, the second-largest gain for any team, though their remaining schedule features many weak offenses.
Baltimore's Lamar Jackson has one rush longer than 20 yards this season and gains at least eight yards on 15 percent of carries, half his previous rate.

The Eagles threw an interception on third-and-9 from their own 46 while leading the Jets 14-12 with two minutes left, then lost 20-14; it was the seventh such situation since 2000, and three of the seven teams passed.
Rookie kickers made 86% (67-78) of postseason field goals since 2000 versus 84% (720-862) for veterans, so the data shows no statistical postseason disadvantage for rookies.
The 49ers used a third-round pick, 99th overall, on Michigan's Jake Moody in the 2023 draft as a cost-effective successor to Robbie Gould.
Denver has twice this season used all three timeouts with at least four minutes left before halftime; Sean Payton had this happen only four times in 258 games with the Saints.
Teams have used all their first-half timeouts above four minutes just 14 times since 2020, including six times by Carolina under Matt Rhule.
The Dolphins were the only one of 223 teams since 2000 favored by at least 13.5 points to fall behind by 14 or more, win, and cover the spread.
Tyreek Hill had 812 receiving yards through six games, second in NFL history behind Don Hutson's 819 in 1942.
Indianapolis rookie quarterback Anthony Richardson might undergo season-ending shoulder surgery.
